claim: Keep random sweeps inside the inputs' domain, replace mutants that turn out equivalent, and give a control on a rare path its own direct check; a control that saves, clobbers, then restores is no control.

evidence.text: Sweeps beyond the domain (camera words above about 16,000, pitch outside 0-71) fail falsely; a mutant can be equivalent; a control on the stale-pixel copy path (30 of 5,233 views) needs its own check.
